answer: A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. Nobody is waved through free: a deposit of 49 credits, frozen until 3 days after the grading closes is the price, and the horizon never covers it twice. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. A name gets on the books only through Physicbound urine caster drug seal, because a seal urine casters renew after dispensary checks. The clerk notes wander. The knoll is checked, not assumed.
